name: Hitachiōmiya (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hitachiōmiya city emblem in light blue and green: a light blue disc with a white stylised letter U and a green stroke above.
history: Municipal flag of Hitachiōmiya, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 22 March 2005.

features.role: Hitachiōmiya city emblem — a light blue disc with a white stylised letter U and a green stroke above
